title: A library entry
description: One manifest, library/<shelf>/<slug>/entry.yaml (design 2026-10-18, section 4.3). The server checks every entry it serves against this file, and refuses to serve the shelf if one fails.

shelf.description: The kind of thing it is. This release serves board, rules and system; the others are the design's, reserved.

summary.description: One sentence, what it is for.

source.description: The name of the shelf it is on.

standing.description: What the entry rests on, as knowledge/INDEX.md says it.

maturity.description: raw is shown and never offered to install.

items.description: What the org must already have. system-kind:safe is a systems.yaml entry of kind safe.

installs.description: Present and non-empty: something to add. Absent or empty: nothing to add. The ops are the change engine's own (create, update, replace, delete). Any string of a value or set may hold "${config.<name>}" (quoted in YAML): exactly that string becomes the supplied value with its type, and a longer one has it put in. Every name must be a property of config.

record.description: <registry>:<id>, as the change engine writes it. The id may be one placeholder, "${config.<name>}", which the person's config fills.

config.description: A JSON Schema of what the person supplies: its properties (each with a type, and a default where it has one) and which are required. It is checked with additionalProperties false, defaults applied.

replaces.description: Reserved for a template that replaces a built-in board on purpose (design 4.5). Not used in this release.
